sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 28 Political Parties Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title, application and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 28 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 28 OF 2002
POLITICAL PARTIES
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order to amend
the Political Parties Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part-I 5th October, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub, dated
5-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:
1. Short title, application
and commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Political Parties
(Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 28th June, 2002.
